crm-integrations.h2-works-with-the-crm: Works with the CRM your team already uses.
crm-integrations.li-closed-won-deals-trigg: Closed-won deals trigger subscription, billing and provisioning workflows automatically.
crm-integrations.li-pre-built-connectors-p: Pre-built connectors plus an open REST API for custom or in-house CRM systems.
crm-integrations.li-quotes-generated-in-at: Quotes generated in ATSuite appear on the CRM opportunity record with status and amount.
crm-integrations.li-two-way-sync-of: Two-way sync of accounts, contacts and opportunities — no duplicate data entry.
crm-integrations.p-atsuite-connects-bi-di: ATSuite connects bi-directionally to leading CRMs — accounts, contacts and opportunities stay in sync, while quotes, approvals and orders flow back automatically. crm-integrations.p-bi-directional-sync-wi: Bi-directional sync with Dynamics Sales entities. Quotes, orders and renewals stay in lockstep.
crm-integrations.p-mirror-pipeline-stages: Mirror pipeline stages and persons. Generate ATSuite quotes directly from a Pipedrive deal.
crm-integrations.p-native-object-mapping-: Native object mapping for Accounts, Opportunities and Products. Approvals route through ATSuite policy.
crm-integrations.p-sync-deals-companies-a: Sync deals, companies and contacts. Push quote PDFs and signed orders back to the deal timeline.
